study_design: Nested case-control study within the Iowa Agricultural Health Study cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 66 prostate cancer cases and 173 healthy controls returned questionnaires, over 99% of which included toenail samples.
reason: The study evaluates prostate cancer generally among cases and healthy controls. The abstract does not analyze an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint, and it does not establish prospective specimen collection before diagnosis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: An increased risk was seen for the highest levels of arsenic (OR = 3.4 confidence interval (CI) of 1.3-8.6 and OR = 2.2, 95% CI of 0.9-5.6) and the highest level of selenium (2.0, 95% CI of 1.0-4.0).
estimate_classifications.reason: The selenium estimate concerns prostate cancer generally; no aggressive disease endpoint is specified.
